verdict.rationale: Brex says its AI agents run autonomously against user-defined policies. The review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses and escalates exceptions, and the audit agent continuously monitors spend. Approval routing, policy enforcement, and receipt matching also run automatically. For custom background workflows, Brex offers webhooks plus documented Zapier, Workato and Pipedream recipes, such as a scheduled monthly CSV export. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuring and customizing the agents, a native user-defined workflow builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous agent behavior.
